entities.summary: Aisha Odeh is a Palestinian writer. As a member of the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine (PFLP), she was sentenced to life imprisonment after she participated in a 1969 supermarket bombing that killed two Israelis. Odeh received an early release in 1979 and has since remained an active participant in Palestinian organisations. She has published three books including an autobiography that details allegations of abuse during her imprisonment.
